correlation_steps_to_scripts.test_step: 1. Install and Launch the HPX app.
Implicit Step: Ensure user is on home screen and ready to interact with printer
2. Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
Implicit Step: Add/search for printer device before accessing it
Implicit Step: Select the printer device card to access device details
3. Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
Implicit Step: Verify shortcuts screen is displayed after clicking shortcuts tile
4. Click on Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
5. The click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
Expected Result: User should be navigated to the 'Add shortcut' screen.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Reusable automation scripting rule for mapping test steps to script lines and intermediary steps, including handling split steps and purpose/supporting steps for the test case 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the Create your own shortcut arrow button in Add new shortcuts screen.'
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test steps and implicit/supporting steps in the correlation array for this test case.
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step from the correlation array is encountered, including implicit/supporting steps.

THEN: Implement automation using the mapped script line(s) and follow all intermediary steps. If a test step maps to multiple script lines, split it into sub-steps (e.g., 1a, 1b), each mapping to one script line, and implement in sequence. Include all implicit/supporting steps even if not in the original manual test steps, as they are required for test case purpose validation.

IMPLEMENTATION: For each test step, use the mapped script line(s) and intermediary steps as provided. For split steps, document and enforce execution order. For purpose/supporting steps, reference the test case name and justify inclusion for test case validation. Do not skip or merge steps. Ensure full script coverage and explicit mapping clarity.
